fact: Registrar-General Hussaini Magaji says Nigeria operates a CAC beneficial ownership register, with free access to the data, used by ICPC, EFCC and NDLEA to trace ownership structures.

The OGP Independent Reporting Mechanism says Nigeria launched its Beneficial Ownership Register in 2023, accessible to government institutions, CSOs, journalists and citizens, and used by regulatory and enforcement agencies.
The Registrar-General said CAC operates as a fully digital, end-to-end registry accessible 24 hours a day, receiving close to 10,000 business registration requests daily.
The Corporate Affairs Commission says companies register on its Company Registration Portal, at no cost for the tax number.
